master.title: MASTER
mixer.chatmix.by_wheel: ChatMix — controlled by the headset wheel
notice.path_broken: {names} could not be connected to the output — that channel may be silent. For details run: sonar-cli doctor
notice.profile_copied: Built-in presets are read-only; switched to the copy '{to}'.
problem.conflicting_sink: {name} is running system-wide and pulls Sonar's output into its own chain, so the output device you picked may be ignored. Close {name} or add Sonar's nodes to its exclusion list.
problem.duplicate_capture: {app} is capturing the stream mix twice (both the “{device}” monitor and “{device} (alternate input)”). Remove one, otherwise everything is heard twice.
problem.mic_not_in_stream: The microphone is not going into the stream mix, so your voice will not be heard. Turn on the microphone switch in the master strip, or add a separate microphone source in OBS.
problem.no_stream_listener: No application is listening to the stream mix. In OBS go to Settings → Audio → Desktop Audio and pick “{device}”.
problem.save_failed: Settings could not be written to disk ({error}). Your changes are live but will be lost on restart.
profile.export.title: Export profile
profile.import.title: Import profile
profile.new.hint: Starts flat: EQ flat, every filter off. Your current profile is left untouched.
profile.no_favorites: No favorites yet — press the star to add one; they line up here for quick switching.
settings.chatmix_invert.hint: Turn this on if the slider moves the wrong way when you turn the headset wheel.
settings.language.hint: Channel and device names do not depend on the language: the device you picked in OBS will not disappear when you switch.
settings.take_over: Make Sonar the system's default output
settings.take_over.hint: While off, no system setting is touched. The previous device is restored on shutdown.
settings.title: Settings
stream.setup.mic_note: With this on, one source is enough. If you added a separate microphone source in OBS, turn this off or your voice goes out twice.
stream.setup.step1: 1. OBS → Settings → Audio → Global Audio Devices → Desktop Audio:
stream.setup.step2: 2. On the same screen set Mic/Auxiliary Audio to Disabled. Do not add another source — capturing the same mix twice makes everything audible twice.
stream.setup.title: Stream setup (OBS)
uninstall.effect.apps: Applications go back to playing straight to the physical devices.
uninstall.effect.channels: The virtual channels are torn down and disappear from PipeWire.
uninstall.effect.default_device: Your default audio device is restored.
uninstall.manual: The rest must be done by hand: they belong to root or to the package manager, and Sonar does not touch them.
uninstall.purge: Delete my settings and profiles too
uninstall.purge.hint: This cannot be undone. While off, everything stays on disk and reinstalling is a single click.
uninstall.title: Uninstall Sonar
welcome.devices.body: The following will appear as virtual audio devices in PipeWire. Do not delete them from your system settings — Sonar's audio path is built on them.
welcome.devices.obs: For OBS all you need is: Settings → Audio → Desktop Audio = “Sonar Stream Mix”. That name does not depend on the language.
welcome.devices.title: What will be created
welcome.install.body: You are ready. The button installs the virtual channels and opens the mixer. You can remove them again from Settings at any time.
welcome.install.done: The virtual channels are installed. To remove them: Settings → Uninstall Sonar.
welcome.install.title: Install
welcome.install_failed: The installation failed. Is PipeWire running? For details run: sonar-cli doctor
welcome.language.body: Pick the interface language. You can change it later in Settings.
welcome.language.title: Language / Dil
welcome.what.channels.body: Application audio is split into named channels — game, chat, media. Each channel gets its own volume and effect chain.
welcome.what.channels.title: Channels
welcome.what.mixes.body: Every channel has two faders: one for your headphones, one for the stream. You hear the copyrighted music; the stream does not.
welcome.what.mixes.title: Two separate mixes
welcome.what.profiles.body: Save as many profiles as you like per channel and switch between them without a gap in the audio.
welcome.what.profiles.title: Profiles
welcome.what.title: What Sonar does
